viewer: Homeowners who locked a 30-year mortgage at 3% in 2021 and have had about $500 a month to spare ever since.
decision: Should my spare $500 a month go toward the 3% mortgage or into T-bills?
promise: We replay every month since rates jumped to see which pile actually ended up bigger after federal income tax, and by how much.
title: 3% Mortgage vs T-Bills: Where Should the $500 Have Gone?
